text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Dyufufufufu... How wonderful. Today is 
such a wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-What is it? Is something wrong, 
Tannhauser-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hee-hee. Wondering what's up? I'd say the 
one in for quite a day today is actually 
you, Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right, initiating charge! Five, four, 
three...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, what!? What's that countdown for!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? Th-Thank you so much Punch...!
